set.body: Public AutomaticDisplayWindow callers currently repeat full traversal, AlgorithmR sampling and sorting for p50/p98 and p90/p98 over identical input. Add a general shared-sample batch API preserving exact/sampled counts, seed determinism, domains, per-window constant expansion and refusal. Retain single-window API semantics. Evidence: public counting iterable, independent exact quantiles and sampled reservoir parity, nonfinite/extreme cases; JVM+JS gates and timing qualification pending machine availability. Consumer PLS Neuro adoption is separate.
set.title: Estimate multiple display windows from one bounded sample
